name: 3D particles form a word
description: Three.js particle hit on a transparent background: thousands of soft glowing points (accent + second colour) spiral in from a scattered cloud and converge onto the surface of a word — or a torus knot / sphere — resolving left to right, hold with a gentle shimmer under a slow camera arc, then optionally blow away; optional bloom. Use for a reveal of a product name, keyword or number, tech/AI intros and transitions between sections (16:9 and 9:16).
